name: Caerulescent-Arete
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are acid rain regions, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
